# Balaam — complete 60-minute shooting script

12 episodes × 5 minutes. 72 scenes, 360 editorial shots. Every second is expanded in timelines/SECONDS.md and seconds.csv. Planned picture length is 3,600 seconds / 86,400 frames at 24 fps. Word windows are editorial estimates. Audio recording, alignment and lip review remain production steps.


# Episode 01 — The Lamp Above the River

Film 00:00:00–00:05:00. Planned episode length 05:00.

## Scene 1 — The ferry

**Place** · Pethor main low landing on river-left bank looking downstream; fixed timber post at shore, low wooden ferry at waterline, bend upstream to screen left.

**Light** · Warm morning sun from screen left at a low angle, soft earth bounce on right cheek, gentle atmospheric depth. Keep shadow direction constant within scene.

**Sound bed** · Water at timber, rope rubbing, distant birds. Carry the bed across cuts in this scene.

**Story basis** · Original Pethor backstory; encounters inspired by prophetic narratives, invented events.
